A1.justification: Both complete 14-page PDFs describe the same Token Prepending research. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and appendices support reliable comparison, including matching retained Appendix A.1-A.5 against the additions in v2.

before.justification: v1 reports original STS, transfer-learning, and MTEB evaluations, together with token-position, initialization, and layer-selection analyses.

after.justification: v2 retains those original experiments and adds results for restarting TP and using TP without a prompt in Tables 16-17.

M1.justification: Section 4 retains the same placeholder initialization, layerwise embedding replacement, TP cutoff, and early-exit procedure. Restart schedules and prompt removal are investigated as experimental variants without revising the proposed algorithm.

E1.justification: The seven main STS datasets, SentEval transfer tasks, and MTEB coverage in Appendix A.2 are retained. The added analyses use existing STS datasets and change prompting or layer configurations rather than dataset or task coverage.

E2.justification: Table 17 introduces an explicitly unprompted LLaMA2-7B control, labeled 'w/o prompt', against 'w/o prompt + TP'. Established benchmark and appendix comparators are retained. The newly discussed CP method is cited but not experimentally compared.

E3.justification: New controls test post-text token placement, TP resumption at layers 9, 10, 11, 16, and 26 with exit at layer 27, and prompt removal. v2 also deletes Table 1's batch-size-16 statement while Section 5.3 retains batch size 1, resolving a reported inconsistency without establishing that timing experiments were rerun.

E4.justification: Appendices A.6-A.7 add focused tests of restarting TP after its usual cutoff and whether TP helps without prompting. Table 3 adds post-text placement cases and removes the whole-prompt-initial Pretended CoT case. The other ablations and supplementary analyses are retained.

E5.justification: Neither version reports repeated-run or seed counts, confidence intervals, or significance tests. The sentence-level correlation distribution shown by the Figure 5 box plot is unchanged.

E6.justification: Tables 1-2 and 4-15 retain their numerical results. Table 3 adds post-text placement scores of 75.54 for PromptEOL and 77.44 for Pretended CoT, while removing the latter's prompt-initial score of 76.53. New restart variants average 76.69-77.21 against the unchanged default's 77.19 (Table 16). Table 17 reports 22.87 without prompting and 27.94 with unprompted TP.

T1.justification: The hidden-state definitions, embedding-replacement equations, and layer bounds are unchanged. Section 4.2.2 merely adds prose identifying f(h) as the function operating on h; it introduces no new mathematical reasoning or formal result.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the claims of training-free, plug-and-play sentence embedding enhancement through backward dependency modeling, with negligible additional inference cost. The added experiments support these existing contributions.

C2.justification: The backward-dependency explanation, prompt-robustness interpretation, and limitation concerning model-, dataset-, and prompt-dependent hyperparameter tuning are retained. The revised placement ranking and new appendix summaries report experimental observations without adding substantive mechanism explanations.

D1.justification: v2 adds a code repository link in the abstract, absent from v1, providing new access information. Appendix A.6 also documents the stopping, resumption, and exit settings for its new experiment.

R1.justification: Related work adds Contrastive Prompting, CP (Cheng et al., 2025), and briefly describes its auxiliary prompt. Additional bibliography entries for Jin et al. and Liu et al. duplicate works already cited in v1; they do not represent additional distinct research.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized attribution, terminology, and grammar corrections, adds acknowledgments and Appendix A.6-A.7, and removes the author-contribution footnote text. The main section sequence and most prose remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v2 adds Tables 16-17, revises Table 3's rows and quotation typography, and adjusts equation spacing and appendix table spacing. Existing Figures 1-5 are retained without substantive visual changes.

improvement.justification: The focused restart and prompt-removal analyses improve empirical scrutiny, the code link adds reproducibility information, and the timing-caption correction resolves an inconsistency. These gains are limited: the main method and benchmark evidence are unchanged, Table 3 drops one previous control, and Appendix A.6 mentions layer 21 although Table 16 reports the slight improvement at layer 26. Overall, the additions provide a modest benefit despite these reporting drawbacks.
